other_conditions: Disability must be at least 40 percent as certified by the Chief Medical Officer.
Candidate must have no source of income or a monthly income not exceeding Rs. 4000.
Candidate may belong to a BPL (Below Poverty Line) family.
If the candidate’s son or grandson is over 20 years old but lives below the poverty line, the candidate is eligible for the grant.
benefits_summary: Eligible disabled persons receive a monthly pension of Rs. 1500, with additional allowances for leprosy‑free individuals, parents of disabled children (Rs. 700 per month for ages 0‑18), and mentally handicapped spouses.
documents_required: Disability certificate issued by the Chief Medical Officer
